name: Scarlet Monastery Cathedral
summary: Within Scarlet Monastery Cathedral, the Crusade keeps its inner sanctum and command seat.

sections.title: Sanctum of Zeal
sections.body: After the Third War, hatred took hold of the Cathedral. The Scourge destroyed Lordaeron, and its surviving zealots turned the complex from a peaceful place of prayer and learning into a stronghold. Beyond the Chapel Gardens stands the grand Crusader's Chapel. There, priests and warriors gather in devotion to their cause. They see every outsider, whatever their race or faction, as a bearer of the undead plague, to be purged by blade and holy fire.

sections.title: The High Inquisitor and Her Commander
sections.body: Scarlet Commander Mograine directs the Cathedral's garrison with iron discipline. High Inquisitor Whitemane is the heart of its fanaticism and a formidable wielder of the Light. Her divine devotion lets her raise fallen champions in battle. Together, Whitemane and Mograine hold the inner chapel against anyone who breaches the monastery gates, keeping the Crusade's grip on northern Lordaeron deadly.

faq.q: What is the Cathedral used for?
faq.answer: The Cathedral holds the Scarlet Crusade's inner sanctum and sacred seat of power within the Monastery. Its leaders conduct religious services and direct military campaigns across Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Who leads the Scarlet Crusade here?
faq.answer: Scarlet Commander Mograine commands the garrison, while High Inquisitor Whitemane holds spiritual authority as a formidable, zealous priestess.

faq.q: Why is the door to the Cathedral locked?
faq.answer: Heavy gates bar intruders from the Cathedral's inner sanctum. Entry requires the Scarlet Key, kept under guard in the Monastery's Library wing.

faq.q: Why are the Crusaders attacking other living humans?
faq.answer: The Scourge destroyed Lordaeron, and the Crusade now sees every outsider as a carrier of undeath. Its zealots shun other factions and execute anyone who approaches their fortresses.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the Crusade twists the Holy Light and Lordaeron's proud heritage into something corrupt. Commanders in Southshore send champions to end its madness.
The Cathedral lies dangerously close to the Undercity. Its zealots seek to exterminate the Forsaken and any Horde allies who stand with them.
